slippage: not modeled; Nautilus FillModel does not provide rate slippage here
execution: Strategy queues bar-close signals for the next bar; runner feeds trade ticks at candle opens, so report prices match common next-open execution.
native_bar_execution_note: Nautilus bar-only market orders fill at same-bar close; this spike does not use that mode for the comparable summary.
timestamp_note: Nautilus order timestamps occur on the queued bar event; report timestamps are normalized back to the corresponding candle-open proxy.
